definitions.explanation: Successfully meeting the required standards, especially in an examination.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}に{合格|ごうかく}する。
{合格|ごうかく}{発表|はっぴょう}
{彼女|かのじょ}は{難関|なんかん}{大学|だいがく}に{合格|ごうかく}し、{家族|かぞく}{全員|ぜんいん}が{喜|よろこ}んだ。
examples.english: She passed the entrance exam for a prestigious university, and the whole family was overjoyed.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{遅|おそ}くまで{勉強|べんきょう}した{甲斐|かい}があって、{志望|しぼう}{校|こう}に{無事|ぶじ}{合格|ごうかく}することができた。
examples.english: All the hard work of studying late every day paid off, and I was able to pass the entrance exam for my school of choice.

notes:
{合格|ごうかく} means passing an exam or meeting a required standard. Most commonly associated with entrance exams in Japan's education system.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {合格|ごうかく}する

PARTICLE USAGE:
- {試験|しけん}に{合格|ごうかく}する: to pass an exam (uses に)
- {大学|だいがく}に{合格|ごうかく}する: to get into a university (uses に)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {合格|ごうかく}{発表|はっぴょう}: announcement of results
- {合格|ごうかく}{点|てん}: passing score/mark
- {合格|ごうかく}{率|りつ}: pass rate
- {合格|ごうかく}{者|しゃ}: successful candidate
- {合格|ごうかく}{通知|つうち}: acceptance notice

ANTONYM:
{不合格|ふごうかく} (failure, not passing). Also: {落|お}ちる is the colloquial verb for failing an exam.
